newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Yield drops on Bahrain 91-day treasury bills.
newsitem.headline: Yield drops on Bahrain 91-day treasury bills.

text.p: The average yield at this week's tender for 10 million dinars of Bahrain 91-day treasury bills dropped to 5.73 percent from 5.76 percent a week earlier, the Bahrain Monetary Agency said on Monday.
The average price rose to 98.573 from 98.564 last week while the minimum price accepted was 98.553.
Banks submitted bids for 16.9 million dinars worth of bills, down from 18.6 million dinars the previous week.
The bills, maturing on November 19, were offered on Monday and will be issued on Wednesday.
